title: Contrix Range-bound Completeness Attestation
description: A range-bound completeness attestation. Event kind: cx.attestation.range_completeness (active in event-kind-registry; the event kind itself carries NO .v1 suffix). Payload schema id: cx.schema.range_completeness_attestation.v1 (schemas keep the .v1 versioning). The attestation asserts that the issuer (and any witnesses) have observed every reducer-input event in a declared range — (from_frontier, to_frontier) bounded by explicit per-actor seq intervals — where each frontier is a Realm-scoped frontier (property name realm_frontier; the security/replication boundary for completeness in v1 is the Realm, not an in-Realm Space container). Distinct from cx.event_batch_receipt (set-bound integrity over an arbitrary chosen subset) and cx.audit.ryw_receipt (per-event RYW hint). Used when verifiers need a completeness claim — i.e., 'no event has been silently withheld from this range' — not just 'the events given are unmodified'. Standalone single-issuer attestations are NOT sufficient for sovereign / multi-writer trust models; deployments requiring strong completeness MUST use a witness_attestation block following the cx.audit.ryw_receipt model (zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §4.1.1).

schema.description: Payload schema id (versioned). The owning Event kind in event-kind-registry.json is cx.attestation.range_completeness (NO .v1 suffix on the event kind).

from_frontier.description: Lower bound of the range (exclusive). The attestation covers events causally after this frontier.

from_seq_exclusive.description: Per-actor seq lower bound (exclusive). -1 means 'from actor genesis'.

to_seq_inclusive.description: Per-actor seq upper bound (inclusive). Issuer asserts completeness of every actor_seq in the half-open interval (from_seq_exclusive, to_seq_inclusive].

actor_seq_ranges.description: Per-actor seq intervals attested. Silent forks frequently appear as a missing slice in a single actor's seq sequence while the global frontier still advances monotonically — explicit per-actor ranges close that gap. MUST cover every actor that produced reducer-input events in (from_frontier, to_frontier].

root.description: Canonical Merkle root over the sorted set of (actor_id, actor_seq, event_id, event_digest) tuples for every reducer-input event in scope. Hash agility per Realm.hash_profile.

count.description: Number of reducer-input events in scope. MUST match the number of leaves used to compute root.

observed_at.description: When the issuer finished observing the scope and computed the attestation.

kind.description: Same semantics as cx.audit.ryw_receipt.witness_attestation: 'federation_witness_attested' requires witnesses[].length >= 2 with pairwise-distinct issuer/controlling_organization/verification_method, each listed by Realm policy in audit.range_completeness_witnesses[]. 'single_source' is the honest declaration for self-attested deployments. Mismatch between kind and witnesses[] cardinality / distinctness / policy listing MUST be rejected. Receivers SHOULD treat single_source attestations as advisory only and not as a sovereign-grade completeness proof.
